clue.text: Soldier briefly in northern half of South American country

indicators.note: in a down clue the northern part is the top, so only the first four of the eight letters are kept

parts.note: Paraguay is a landlocked country in South America

explanation.surface: A soldier is stationed in the north of a South American country.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Soldier briefly' is the short form of paratrooper, a member of the Parachute Regiment.
explanation.definitionFit: Short informal word for a paratrooper, a soldier trained to drop by parachute.

clue.text: Animal has mother over 50

indicators.note: in a down clue the first piece sits above the second

parts.note: mamma is an old-fashioned word for mother
L is the Roman numeral for fifty

explanation.surface: A creature has a mother who is over fifty.
explanation.definitionFit: A mammal is a warm-blooded creature that suckles its young, so a kind of animal.

clue.text: Lecture can ramble — there's a lack of enthusiasm

indicators.note: to ramble is to wander aimlessly, so these letters wander into a new order

explanation.surface: A lecture can drone on, leaving the audience unenthusiastic.
explanation.definitionFit: Reluctance is unwillingness, a want of keenness to do something.

clue.text: After topless garment you had toed the line

indicators.note: the second piece comes after the first
the top letter of the garment word is removed in this down clue

parts.note: a robe is a long loose garment
ye is an old word for you, and 'd is the short form of had

explanation.surface: After wearing a revealing outfit you did as you were told.
explanation.definitionFit: To toe the line is to conform or comply, which is to have done as ordered.

clue.text: After being put right, he can end improved

indicators.note: putting something right means rearranging it, so these letters are reordered

explanation.surface: Once corrected, he can finish with a better result.
explanation.definitionFit: Something enhanced has been made better or increased in quality.

clue.text: Material in venue covering the ceiling

indicators.note: the covering of the top of this down word, its first letter, is taken away

parts.note: a place is a venue where something happens

explanation.surface: Fabric in a hall is draped across the ceiling.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Material' is the definition, not a hint at fabric hung in the hall.
explanation.definitionFit: Lace is a fine openwork fabric, a material made of looped thread.

clue.text: Time to engage in walk up — bad initial slope for climber

indicators.note: the time letter is to go into the reversed walk word
in a down clue up means the word for walk is read bottom to top

parts.note: to hoof it is slang for to walk
ill means bad, as in ill will

explanation.surface: Walking uphill takes time and makes a mountaineer feel poorly on the first incline.
explanation.walkthrough: 'up' turns HOOF into FOOH, and T goes inside to make FOOTH.
explanation.definitionFit: Low hills at the base of a range are the first rising ground a mountaineer meets.

clue.text: Hard setter making an impression?

parts.note: a substance that sets hard and takes the impression of a seal, not a tough crossword setter

explanation.definitionFit: This wax is melted on a letter, stamped with a signet and hardens to hold the mark.

clue.text: Wonder about a queen being well-informed

indicators.note: the wonder word goes round the other pieces

parts.note: awe is a feeling of wonder
R is short for regina, Latin for queen

explanation.surface: A queen is marvelled at for being knowledgeable.
explanation.definitionFit: Being knowledgeable or conscious of something is the same as being well-informed.

clue.text: Indian city bar at which girl has mineral

parts.note: to ban is to bar
gal is an informal word for a girl
ore is a mineral from which metal is extracted

explanation.surface: In a bar in an Indian city a girl has some mineral.
explanation.definitionFit: Bangalore, now officially Bengaluru, is a large city in southern India.

clue.text: Fighting force will carry our weapons, etc

indicators.note: the fighting force word carries the other piece inside it

parts.note: an army is a fighting force

explanation.surface: Troops will be transporting our arms and equipment.
explanation.definitionFit: An armoury is a store of arms, or the stock of weapons and kit itself.

clue.text: Encouragement at table to get moving

indicators.note: the letters are set in motion and rearranged

explanation.surface: Urging diners at the table to get up and go.
explanation.definitionFit: Abettal is an old word for abetting, the act of helping or egging on.

clue.text: Character in Athens leading group as guide

indicators.note: the Greek letter comes before the group word

parts.note: pi is a letter of the Greek alphabet
a lot is a group, as of items at auction

explanation.surface: A Greek tour leader takes a party round as their guide.
explanation.definitionFit: A pilot steers ships through harbours, so one who guides.

clue.text: This volume taken 18 won't be needed for a staycation

definitions.text: This volume taken 18 won't be needed for a staycation

parts.words: This volume taken 18 won't be needed for a staycation
parts.note: a book of handy foreign expressions carried abroad is useless when holidaying at home

explanation.definitionFit: Travellers pack a little book of translated expressions for trips abroad, not for a holiday at home.

clue.text: Trick to give welcoming area new frontage

indicators.note: the front letter of the welcoming area word is swapped for a different one

parts.note: reception is the area where guests are greeted in a hotel or office

explanation.surface: A ploy to give a hotel lobby a fresh facade.
explanation.walkthrough: The clue does not name the new first letter; the definition settles it as D.
explanation.definitionFit: A deception is a trick that misleads someone.

clue.text: In days gone by cleric would enter in holy manner

indicators.note: the cleric goes inside the word for in a holy manner

parts.note: piously means devoutly, in a holy way
Rev is short for Reverend, a cleric's title

explanation.surface: In the old days a vicar would walk into church devoutly.
explanation.definitionFit: Previously means earlier, at a time now past.

clue.text: Bard's character could be boring old fool, we fancy

indicators.note: fancy as a verb means to imagine, so the letters are reimagined in a new order

explanation.surface: We think a Shakespeare role might be a tedious elderly clown.
explanation.walkthrough: 'could be' links the definition to the wordplay. The Bard is Shakespeare, and this is another name for Puck in A Midsummer Night's Dream.
explanation.definitionFit: This mischievous sprite is a role in a Shakespeare comedy, also called Puck.

clue.text: General style for theatreland

parts.note: broad means general, as in a broad outline
a way is a manner or style of doing something

explanation.surface: A military officer's manner is suited to the stage district.
explanation.definitionFit: This New York avenue gives its name to the city's main theatre district.

clue.text: One hears guides in a foreign country

indicators.note: what one hears is a word that sounds the same but is spelt differently

parts.note: oversees means supervises or guides

explanation.surface: Someone listens to tour guides on a trip abroad.
explanation.definitionFit: Being abroad means being across the sea, in another land.

clue.text: Those trying to cut down on unhealthy habit do like e-cigarettes?

definitions.text: Those trying to cut down on unhealthy habit do
definitions.meaning: people reducing their tobacco habit puff fewer cigarettes
vaping devices produce vapour, not fumes from burning

explanation.surface: Would-be quitters might say the same of vaping devices.
explanation.definitionFit: Read as two words it describes cutting down on tobacco; as one it means producing no fumes.

clue.text: First principle sailor grasped — not to finish on this!

indicators.note: the sailor is held inside the first-principle word

parts.note: a seed is the origin from which something grows
AB, able-bodied seaman, is a sailor

explanation.surface: A rule learned from a seaman: never end up down there!
explanation.walkthrough: The surface has the sailor grasping, but here it is the first principle that holds the sailor.
explanation.definitionFit: The floor of the ocean is where a sinking ship ends up, so no sailor wants to end there.

clue.text: The last few pages of a book maybe penned by Colin Dexter

definitions.text: The last few pages of a book maybe

indicators.note: the answer is enclosed within the author's name, as if written inside it

explanation.surface: Final pages possibly written by the Inspector Morse novelist.
explanation.walkthrough: Colin Dexter wrote the Inspector Morse detective novels.
explanation.definitionFit: An alphabetical list of topics usually sits at the back of a book.

clue.text: Romantic GP possibly wanting Eastern girl

parts.note: a GP, a general practitioner, is a doctor, DR
Amy is a girl's name

explanation.surface: A family doctor perhaps pining for an Asian woman.
explanation.walkthrough: 'possibly' marks GP as an example of a doctor; 'wanting' is only a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Dreamy means idealistic and sentimental, given to romantic fancies.

clue.text: Animals with distinctive marks crossing river

indicators.note: the marks word goes across the river letter, holding it

parts.note: badges are distinguishing marks or emblems

explanation.surface: Creatures with striking markings swim across a stream.
explanation.definitionFit: Badgers are burrowing black-and-white striped mammals.

clue.text: Still time when poet watches sunset?

definitions.meaning: a poetic word for ..., the close of the day

explanation.definitionFit: It means yet or still, and in verse it is an old word for evening.

clue.text: Severely wounded entering a small city

indicators.note: the wounded word goes in between the other pieces

parts.note: Ely is a small cathedral city in Cambridgeshire
cut means wounded

explanation.surface: Badly hurt person arrives in a little cathedral town.
explanation.walkthrough: ELY is a small cathedral city in eastern England, much used in crosswords.
explanation.definitionFit: Acutely means intensely or keenly, as in acutely painful.

clue.text: Will this change just after Christmas? Yes, right!

definitions.text: Will this change just after Christmas?

parts.note: yea is an old word for yes

explanation.surface: Someone asks if things alter after Christmas and gets a sarcastic reply.
explanation.definitionFit: A new twelve-month period begins on January 1st, a week after the festive season.

clue.text: Old part of church encountered with enthusiasm typically

parts.note: the nave is the main body of a church
a rage is a craze or passion, as in all the rage

explanation.surface: An ancient section of a church met with eager interest, as usual.
explanation.definitionFit: On average means as a rule, usually, in typical cases.

clue.text: Proposition presenting some problem, mathematically

indicators.note: some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A theorem that sets out a maths problem.
explanation.definitionFit: In mathematics a subsidiary statement proved to help prove a theorem.
